originalTitle: Nvidia’s Q3 earnings hit the mark, without mentioning the whole Jensen Huang thing

content: Interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress announced the company’s Q3 earnings on Tuesday, without initially mentioning former CEO Jensen Huang or the details of his departure, or possible attempt at a return. On the earnings call accompanying the release, board chair Harvey Jones kicked things off by saying the board “does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO,” and that “we will not be addressing or taking questions on today’s call regarding the circumstances of Jensen’s resignation and the ongoing investigation,” before Kress started with her comments on the results. As it predicted in the last financial update, Nvidia is now on the list of companies that have pulled in over $100 billion in a single quarter, with revenues of $115.8 billion, up 103 percent from the same period last year and higher than its expectation of $108 billion. This quarter’s figures include data center revenues of $107.6 billion, which were up 110 percent, and edge computing (which includes the consumer gaming PC business and devices like the new RTX Spark laptops) revenue of $8.2 billion, up 42 percent. The company reported $65.3 billion in profit, a new record. > “Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” said Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.” In the fourth quarter, Nvidia expects revenues of $130 billion. Update, November 17th: Added comments from Nvidia’s earnings call.
chineseTitle: 英伟达第三季度财报达到预期目标，却没有提及整个黄仁勋事件

chineseContent: 英伟达临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 周二宣布了该公司第三季度财报，但最初没有提及前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 或他离职的细节，也没有提及可能的回归尝试。在伴随该消息发布的财报电话会议上，董事会主席哈维·琼斯首先表示，董事会“不打算恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官职位”，并且“我们不会在今天的电话会议上就詹森辞职的情况和正在进行的调查提出问题”，然后克雷斯开始对结果发表评论。正如其在上次财务更新中所预测的那样，英伟达目前已跻身单季度收入超过 1000 亿美元的公司之列，营收为 1158 亿美元，较去年同期增长 103%，高于其 1080 亿美元的预期。本季度的数据包括数据中心收入 1076 亿美元，增长 110%，边缘计算（包括消费者游戏 PC 业务和新型 RTX Spark 笔记本电脑等设备）收入 82 亿美元，增长 42%。该公司公布利润 653 亿美元，创下新纪录。 > NVIDIA 临时首席执行官兼执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 表示：“我们的动力是真实的。NVIDIA 是卓越的技术领导者，其动力源自我们员工的不懈创新。” “Vera Rubin 迎来了一个爆炸性的开端，我们的路线图已步入正轨，我们的雄心从未如此之大。” Nvidia预计第四季度营收将达到1300亿美元。 11 月 17 日更新：添加了 Nvidia 财报电话会议的评论。
